title: Session restore for serverless jobs is now in Beta
body: Restore the Python variables and Spark session from a serverless compute job run into a new interactive notebook, so you can debug a failure or explore results without rerunning the job. Databricks automatically captures a state snapshot when an eligible run fails, runs 30 minutes or longer, or is cancelled, and keeps it for 7 days after the run completes. This feature is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). See [Session restore for serverless jobs](/aws/en/notebooks/schedule-notebook-jobs#session-restore-serverless-jobs).
